speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: This is applied consistently to both corporate and individual taxpayers.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: The current tax treatment that we have was introduced before the advent of companies like Grab and Uber.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I do agree that perhaps the tax regimes for taxi drivers and part-time private hire drivers should be different.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: But I think for full-time private hire drivers, it should be the same and I am just wondering whether the Minister would consider establishing, say, a minimum mileage clock, after which then the private hire driver is considered full-time and can then enjoy the same tax regime as a taxi driver.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: When that is done and clearer, I think the tax treatment can also be adjusted accordingly.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: Because as I said earlier, the reviews are being done in parallel.
